ios.desc:
With Movie Player, you can now watch all your favorite films on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod Touch.
Movie Player supports all popular file formats — no video conversion required!

Supported Formats:
DivX, AVI, FLV, MOV, WMV, MPG, MPEG, MPEG1, MPEG2, MPEG4, MP4, M4V, MPV, VOB, TS, OGV, OGM, MKV, DV, ASF, 3GP, M2P, M2TS, M2V, GXF ...


Features at a Glance:

• Compatibility:
Movie Player plays almost any video format.

• File Management:
Transfer films via USB or Wi-Fi to your iPhone or iPad.

• Integration:
Movie Player even plays videos from email attachments, your web browser, and many other apps.

• Folders:
Sort and group your films using folders.

• Playlist:
With the Playlist function, you can watch several movies in a row without interruption.


Pro Features:

• Subtitles:
Full subtitle support.

• Pro Audio:
All codecs, audio tracks, and an equalizer.

• Password Protection:
Lock folders with a password.

• Color Adjustments:
Adjust brightness, contrast, and color.

• Streaming:
Full UPnP streaming support.

A monthly or annual subscription is required to access all Pro Features.

---

Subscriptions automatically renew monthly or yearly, depending on your plan, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. To avoid automatic renewal, turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. You can manage your subscription at any time from your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.movie-player.net/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.movie-player.net/privacy-policy/
